related_games.title: TurboCrib
original_metadata: Create a Cribbage-style card game with classic scoring combinations and a normal round structure (dealer, 4-card hands, crib, pegging round), but using a deck extended with two joker cards and special card-value rules. Jokers are wild: when used, they take on the value of any other card in the deck, including aces, and aces may be 0, 1, or 11. The ace’s value is chosen by each player at the moment it’s relevant (during pegging when played, or during each player’s individual hand-count when the up-card is shared for hand/crib counting). The game is played with a physical-feeling board for pegging advancement and score counting: there are two alternating scoring markers, gallion (the only marker type that can win) and screw. The scoring marker alternates per scoring event (not per physical marker type), and scoring/advancement uses a dedicated board that ends at 161. If the screw would reach/past the 161 hole first, it stops right before 161 and any unused advancement is carried to the opponent as “booty.” Booty cannot be used to win the game. If a player still reaches the end state with booty having accumulated such that it would matter for victory, the game is automatically extended by 30 points: the new win target is 191, with the same gallion-only win condition. In the extension, booty continues to exist, but it cannot trigger another extension (only one extension total). Jokers add additional tactical control: if a player is dealt a joker (in their hand or in the crib), they may either call out its chosen value normally, or sacrifice the joker at any time to flip the gallion/screw positions of their opponent, to block them from winning—especially near the end.

profile.rules: 原nA初始状态、nt/ye载入、Zo/rA保存、ae离线生产、Ue事务、fi/or/ar计时系统、dr重置和re派生状态的规范AST逐一保持。原点击产量、资金门槛、批量买卖、升级条件、随机种子、Buff/金饼干、研究/花园/股票/升天规则不降难度、不送金币、不改计时。真实SDK发现、事件订阅、在线排行、购买、实时会话、云存档和宿主震动调用退役；原本地经营和UI反馈保留。
